about.tagline: Local-first prompt library and versioning tool
ai.connected-providers-hint: Connect a provider once and all of its catalog models are instantly available — pick them from the model picker next to Run. API keys are stored encrypted with your OS keychain.
ai.disconnect-desc: The stored API key and model preferences are removed. Run history recorded with this provider is kept.
ai.no-providers: Connect a provider to run prompts against real models.
ai.test-dialog-desc: The connection check runs on one model — pick it. Models that can hold a conversation are listed first.
ai.title: AI Providers
appearance.editor-mode-hint: Read-only versions always open in Preview.
appearance.theme-hint: System Default follows your OS appearance.

appearance.tray: Keep running in the system tray

appearance.tray-load-error: Tray settings could not be loaded.
appearance.tray-unavailable: The system tray is not available on this desktop.
blocks.bake_hint: Append the active blocks to a new version and remove them from the list
blocks.bake_warning: Active blocks will be appended to the end of the new version’s text and removed from the block list. Unsaved editor edits are included in the version.
blocks.content_placeholder: Text appended to the prompt when this block is active
blocks.hint: Active blocks are appended to the end of the prompt when it runs or is copied.

compare_dialog.title: Compare versions

connect_provider.changing_url_clears_key: Changing the URL clears the stored key.

connect_provider.custom_hint: Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, any /v1 endpoint
connect_provider.declare_models: Connected — declare models to use them
connect_provider.enter_corrected_key: Enter a corrected key and try again.

data.backups-hint: A backup is also written automatically once a day; the last 10 are kept.
data.danger-zone-hint: Hard-deletes every prompt currently in Trash. This cannot be undone.
data.empty-trash-desc: Every prompt currently in Trash — including all of its versions, notes and run history — will be hard-deleted. This cannot be undone.
data.library-transfer-hint: Export writes the whole library as JSON; import merges a JSON export back in.
data.title: Data & Backup
dialog.all_dimensions_optional: All dimensions are optional, but at least one is required. Ratings are append-only — a new rating replaces the previous one for display.
dialog.change_notes: Change notes become the changelog for this prompt — future-you will thank you.
dialog.close_without_saving_desc: The entered title, description, and content will be lost.
dialog.content_placeholder: You are a senior engineer reviewing code for…
dialog.draft_generated: Draft generated — review it before creating the prompt
dialog.duplicate_as_variation_desc: Creates a new branch whose first version copies {label}'s content. You can then evolve it independently of main.
dialog.generate_placeholder: Describe the prompt you want, e.g. “A code reviewer that flags security issues first, answers in Markdown.”
dialog.name: Name
dialog.replace_content_desc: You've already written content. Applying the generated draft replaces it.
dialog.result_summary_placeholder: What did you use it for, and how did it go?
dialog.title: Title
dialog.what_changed_placeholder: e.g. Tightened the tone rules after a verbose output; added a JSON output example.
editor.autosave-drafts-hint: Persist in-progress edits as you type. When off, changes are kept only in memory until you save them as a new version — leaving the prompt discards them.
editor.title: Editor
editor.word-wrap-hint: Wrap long lines in the editor instead of scrolling horizontally.
editor_tab.discard_confirm_desc: The editor will return to the saved text of {label}. Unsaved edits, including an applied AI improvement, will be lost.
editor_tab.improved_draft_applied: Improved draft applied — save the changes or create a new version to keep it
history_compare.pick_another: selected — pick one more version to compare
history_tab.restore_desc: The current pointer moves to this version. No history is lost — you can switch back at any time.
history_view.no_activity_hint: New versions across all prompts will show up here.
history_view.subtitle: Recent versions across your whole library
history_view.title: History
import_markdown.creates_separate: This creates a separate local prompt from the reviewed text and records both source URLs in a note. It does not publish the content.
import_markdown.review: Review a public Markdown file before adding it as a new prompt.
import_markdown.title: Import Markdown prompt
inspector.no_model_runs: No model runs yet — use the Run button in the prompt header to compare models.
inspector.no_ratings: No ratings yet for {label} — use Rate above after trying it.
inspector.title: Inspector
left_rail.collections_hint: Drag by the edges to reorder. Drop onto a folder to nest it.
left_rail.delete_collection_desc: Delete "{name}" and all its subfolders? Prompts in those folders will no longer be associated with any collection.
left_rail.delete_tag_desc: Delete "{name}"? The tag is removed from every prompt; the prompts themselves remain.
licenses.load_error: Could not load the third-party notices file.
licenses.no_license: No license file ships with this package; its declared license ({license}) applies.
licenses.third_party: PromptBr0 bundles {count} third-party packages under the licenses listed below.
main_pane.delete_prompt_desc: This permanently deletes the prompt, all its versions, and all associated data. Notes saved from this prompt are kept.
main_pane.delete_version_desc: Run results and ratings will be permanently removed. Version notes become prompt-level notes, and surviving version numbers stay unchanged. This cannot be undone.
main_pane.description_placeholder: e.g. Security-focused system prompt for code review
main_pane.improved_draft_applied: Improved draft applied — save the changes or create a new version to keep it
main_pane.in_trash: This prompt is in Trash. Content is read-only until restored.
main_pane.no_ai_providers: No AI providers connected — connect one in Settings → AI Providers
main_pane.no_models: No models available — connect a provider first
main_pane.permanently_delete_desc: All versions, notes, ratings and runs are removed. This cannot be undone.
main_pane.run_complete_open: Run complete — {n}/{total} succeeded — open it from Results
main_pane.run_finished: Run finished for "{title}" — open it from Results
main_pane.select_prompt_hint: Pick a prompt from the list, or press ⌘K to search.
main_pane.trash_readonly: This prompt is in Trash. Content is read-only until restored.
manage_models.catalog_not_fetched_yet: The model catalog has not been fetched yet — catalog-backed providers will list models after a refresh.
manage_models.connect_to_see_models: Connect a provider to see its models here.
manage_models.subtitle: Customize which models appear in the model selector
manage_models.title: Manage models
model_picker.max_models: Max {count} models — deselect one to pick another.
model_picker.no_models: No models available yet — connect a provider and its models just work.
notes_tab.add_note_placeholder: Add a note about this prompt…
notes_tab.delete_note_desc: Notes are removed from search immediately. This cannot be undone.
notes_tab.notes_hint: Notes are searchable from ⌘K and can attach to a specific version.
prompt_list.clipboard_unavailable: The system clipboard is unavailable. Try again.
prompt_list.could_not_refresh_version: The current saved version could not be refreshed.
prompt_list.create_first: Create your first prompt with the + button above.
prompt_list.create_saved_first: Create a saved prompt in the library first.
prompt_list.deleted_prompts_landing: Deleted prompts land here and can be restored.
prompt_list.fill_variables: Fill all required variables to enable Copy.
prompt_list.no_collections: No collections yet — create one from the left rail.
prompt_list.no_saved_version: This prompt has no saved version to duplicate
prompt_list.preview_could_not_render: The preview could not be rendered. Try again.
prompt_list.prompt_could_not_open: This prompt could not be opened. Try again.
prompt_list.star_from_list: Star a prompt from the list to pin it here.
prompt_list.try_different_search: Try a different search, or clear the filters.
quick-access.enable-hint: Opens the prompt palette while PromptBr0 is already running.
quick-access.hint-1: You can always choose Open prompt palette from the app menu, even when the shortcut is disabled.
quick-access.hint-2: The palette copies only when you explicitly choose Copy or press Command/Ctrl+Enter. Closing it clears the search, variable values, and preview.
quick-access.hint-3: On macOS, Quick access remains available after the library window closes while PromptBr0 is running. On Windows and Linux, closing the library exits the app unless Keep running in the system tray is turned on under Settings → Appearance.
quick-access.load-error: Quick access settings could not be loaded.
quick-access.save-error: Quick access settings could not be saved. Your edits are still here.
quick-access.shortcut-hint: Choose Record new shortcut, then press your preferred key combination.
quick-access.title: Quick access
quick_palette.preview_hint: Preview appears after all required variables are filled.
results_tab.delete_model_run_desc: This permanently removes all {count} model results, including ratings and judge scores. Saved notes are kept.
results_tab.delete_model_run_desc_one: This permanently removes this model result, including ratings and judge scores. Saved notes are kept.
results_tab.delete_run_desc: The {tool} run from {time} is removed. This cannot be undone.
results_tab.runs_hint: Run this prompt against models with the Run button, or log a run each time you use it — rated outcomes over time become its effectiveness record.
run_compare.delete_prompt_desc: The prompt moves to Trash with its full history. You can restore it from there.
run_compare.delete_result_desc: This permanently removes the result, its rating, and judge scores. Notes saved from it are kept.
run_compare.delete_version_desc: Run results and ratings will be permanently removed. Version notes become prompt-level notes, and surviving version numbers stay unchanged. This cannot be undone.
run_compare.permanently_delete_desc: All versions, notes, ratings and runs are removed. This cannot be undone.
run_compare.replace_ratings_desc: Some runs already have an outcome rating. Applying the judge scores overwrites them.

run_window.close_confirm_desc: Your edits to the prompt text will be lost.
run_window.rebuild_confirm_desc: The text was edited manually. Rebuilding with the new block toggles discards those edits.

suggestions.hint: Variations proposed by agents — nothing becomes active until you approve it
